summary: Iteration 3 backend + frontend validation for CSV export, daily finance trend, QRIS card (admin+member views), recurring/subscription targets with auto-advance & pay flow, announcement->notification bell, ID/EN language toggle with persistence, sidebar collapse/expand toggle beside logo, and 'ini ruang privat mu' subtitle. 8/8 pytest cases pass. All Playwright UI checks pass. No regressions.

issues: Repeat of iter2 A11y warning: DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby — non-blocking, still logged in console.

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to shadcn Dialogs to silence Radix a11y warnings (carried over from iter2).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend _advance_due only rolls forward while today > d; combined with pay_target's while nxt<=today loop this correctly handles arbitrary lateness. Good.
GET /api/targets performs a per-target write inside the read handler; acceptable at MVP scale but consider batching or move to a scheduled task if the list grows large.

QRIS is stored in the singleton settings document as base64. 2MB frontend cap is reasonable; server has no server-side size validation — could reject oversized payloads to protect Mongo doc size limit (16MB).
Notifications list has no per-user filtering; unread is derived from user.notif_seen_at which is fine, but items are global. Acceptable for a small community portal.
server.py is now ~640 lines with 13 feature areas; still readable but nearing the 700-line threshold — consider splitting into routers per resource when adding the next module.
